meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 的容器会用 OpenCode 作为代理后端,而不是只用默认的 Claude;OpenCode 通过自身配置对接 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、Google 等模型服务。
howto.when: 想让 NanoClaw 改用 OpenCode 时使用;预检发现相关文件缺失就执行安装;装好后某组的 provider 被设为 opencode 并重启后对该组生效。

say.text: 给代码库加上 OpenCode provider 并重建镜像。
say.note: 会复制文件、接线、装 SDK 并跑校验。

say.text: 把 group-1 的 provider 切换成 opencode。
say.note: 对应文档中的切换命令与重启。

say.text: 按 DeepSeek 示例配 OPENCODE_* 环境变量。
say.note: 模型密钥需先在 OneCLI 注册。

howto.what_en: After install, NanoClaw's containers run agents through OpenCode instead of only the default Claude; OpenCode connects to model services such as DeepSeek, OpenRouter and Google via its own config, not the Anthropic Agent SDK.
howto.when_en: Run to add OpenCode as an agent provider. Install runs when pre-flight checks find provider files missing; a group then uses OpenCode once its provider is set to opencode and it is restarted.

say_en.text: Add the OpenCode provider to the codebase and rebuild the image.
say_en.note: Copies files, wires barrels, installs SDK, runs checks.
Runs the config update command and restarts the group.

say_en.text: Configure OPENCODE_* env vars like the DeepSeek example.
say_en.note: Register the model key in OneCLI first.
